title: Missed Visits, Missed Evaluations and Suspension Limits — Workers' Compensation Referral
content:
# Missed visits, missed evaluations and suspension limits

On a Workers' Compensation Referral, the program decides what follows when an injured worker misses a visit: whether a late-cancellation or no-show fee may be charged to the worker, how many consecutive missed visits lead to a non-compliance review with the adjuster, how long a referral may stay suspended before discharge, and whether a missed Functional Capacity Evaluation is billed to the carrier and at what amount.

| Program | Missed-visit fee chargeable to worker | Consecutive missed visits before adjuster review | Longest suspension before discharge (calendar days) | Missed FCE billed to carrier | Missed-evaluation fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Employer Direct Early Intervention | No | 2 | 14 | No | $0.00 |
| Workers' Comp Outpatient Therapy | No | 2 | 30 | No | $0.00 |
| Workers' Comp Post-Surgical Therapy | No | 2 | 30 | No | $0.00 |
| Work Conditioning Program | No | 2 | 14 | No | $0.00 |
| Work Hardening Program | No | 1 | 14 | No | $0.00 |
| Functional Capacity Evaluation | No | 1 | 0 | Yes | $250.00 |

## Definitions

- **Missed-visit fee chargeable to worker** — whether a late-cancellation or no-show fee may be charged to the injured worker.
- **Consecutive missed visits before adjuster review** — the consecutive missed visits after which treatment is suspended for a non-compliance review with the adjuster.
- **Longest suspension before discharge** — the calendar days a referral may stay suspended before discharge; 0 where suspension is not used.
- **Missed FCE billed to carrier** — whether a missed Functional Capacity Evaluation appointment is billed to the carrier.
- **Missed-evaluation fee** — the amount billed to the carrier for a missed Functional Capacity Evaluation; $0.00 where not billable.

## Questions answered by the table

**Can any program charge the injured worker a missed-visit fee?** No; every program shows No.

**After how many consecutive missed visits does the adjuster review start?** 2 in the first four programs; 1 in Work Hardening Program and Functional Capacity Evaluation.

**How long may a suspension last?** 14 calendar days in Employer Direct Early Intervention, Work Conditioning Program and Work Hardening Program; 30 in the two therapy programs; Functional Capacity Evaluation shows 0 because it does not use suspension.

**Which program bills the carrier for a missed evaluation?** Only Functional Capacity Evaluation, with a missed-evaluation fee of $250.00; every other program lists $0.00.
